name: LLM Creative Story-Writing Benchmark
intro: LLM Creative Story-Writing Benchmark 使用 400 个固定创意简报评估故事创作。当前官方流程对同一简报的完整故事进行双顺序、多评判模型成对比较，校正位置偏差后拟合 Thurstone 全局比较分数，并通过双重 bootstrap 给出置信区间。
build_method: 固定专家创意简报, 多模型成对评判
metric: Thurstone comparison score, win probability, 95% CI
task_type: 创意故事生成, 成对偏好评测
eval_feature: 双顺序评判, 位置偏差校正, 双重 bootstrap
build_method_en: Fixed expert creative briefs, multi-model pairwise judging
eval_feature_en: Dual-order judging, position-bias correction, two-way bootstrap
intro_en: LLM Creative Story-Writing Benchmark evaluates story generation with 400 fixed creative briefs. Its current official workflow compares completed stories for the same brief in both visible orders with multiple judge models, corrects position bias, fits global Thurstone comparison scores, and estimates uncertainty with a two-way bootstrap.
metric_en: Thurstone comparison score, win probability, 95% CI
drawio_review_note: No associated paper was found. Aligned with official lechmazur/writing repository snapshot 0286ecf. The current leaderboard uses 400 fixed briefs with ten required narrative elements and 600–800-word tagged stories, retains completed stories without score imputation, compares matched stories in both visible orders with multiple evaluators, parses signed margins, corrects side-position bias, averages opposite-order judgments, fits global Thurstone comparison scores, and bootstraps both stories and evaluators. The repository's archived absolute 0–10, 18-dimension workflow is not presented as the current method.
